entries.title: Standing Waves on a Vibrating String
entries.description: A taut 3D string represented by a series of connected spheres vibrates between two fixed supports, forming standing waves with nodes and antinodes that glow and leave faint trails, while sliders and labels show frequency, wavelength, and amplitude changes.

entries.title: Ripple Tank with Interfering Sound Waves
entries.description: A shallow rectangular “water” surface made of a grid of small boxes pulses up and down as two sound sources at opposite edges emit circular waves that propagate, overlap, and create an interference pattern visualized with color gradients and moving contour lines.

entries.title: Resonating Wine Glass Shattered by Sound
entries.description: A transparent glass cup made of thin curved shells sits on a table while an invisible speaker emits a pulsing sound wave visualized as expanding semi-transparent rings; as the driving frequency approaches resonance, the glass vibrates more intensely until it cracks into bouncing fragments.

entries.title: Chladni Plate Sand Pattern Formation
entries.description: A square metal plate fixed at its center vibrates up and down at selectable frequencies while a cloud of tiny sand particles bounces on its surface, gradually migrating and clustering into standing-wave nodal patterns traced with bright color lines over a light background.

entries.title: Acoustic Resonance Inside an Organ Pipe
entries.description: A vertical pipe with one open and one closed end contains a column of air represented by translucent segments whose brightness oscillates with pressure peaks; animated arrows show particle velocity and a side panel displays adjustable frequency and resulting harmonic mode.

entries.title: Vibrating Tuning Fork and Radiating Sound Field
entries.description: A 3D tuning fork vibrates near a small sphere representing an “ear,” with the fork’s prongs flexing back and forth and emitting concentric, semi-transparent pressure shells that expand outward, reflect from walls, and gently push a cloud of suspended dust particles.

entries.title: Suspension Bridge Under Periodic Traffic-Induced Vibration
entries.description: A long suspension bridge with cables, towers, and a flexible deck vibrates as cars (small boxes) periodically cross; the deck flexes, cables oscillate, and colored displacement markers and trails highlight nodes, antinodes, and resonant amplification in different modes.

entries.title: Seismic Wave Propagation Through Layered Ground
entries.description: A cross-sectional 3D block of layered soil and rock is shaken at one end, sending P- and S-wave pulses (color-coded expanding fronts) through transparent layers with different stiffness, causing surface buildings (small boxes) to sway and sometimes topple based on the local ground motion.

entries.title: Vibrating Drumhead Membrane Modes

entries.title: Sound-Driven Levitation of Lightweight Particles
entries.description: Two opposed speakers generate a standing acoustic field between them, visualized as alternating bright and dim planes; tiny spheres (styrofoam beads) drift and then get trapped at pressure nodes, forming stable floating clusters that rearrange when frequency or phase is changed.

entries.title: Sound Pulse in a 3D Room with Echoes and Absorption
